text.p: Southern Co said Tuesday Bill Guthrie has been named president its restructured Fossil/Hydro Group.
The company said it has restructured the Group to combine its fossil and hydro power generation technical resources and expertise into one organization.

It said Guthrie will be responsible for wholesale power marketing, plant operations, engineering and power generation, system planning, research and environmental affairs, procurement and materials and fuel services.
"This change will provide us more efficiencies and greater flexibility as our industry transitions to a more competitive marketplace," chief executive A.W. Dahlberg said.

"Our customers will see no difference in quality of service, cost of product or reliability from Southern Co or its operating companies in the southeastern United States. The transition will be totally seamless -- transparent to the customer."
Ownership and operation of the power plants will not be affected by the change, the company said.
